description: This file defines the StepAdapter class, a custom PagerAdapter for use with a ViewPager in an Android application. It manages the creation and configuration of views representing steps in a showcase or tutorial sequence, using a list of Step objects contained within a ShowcaseFragment.

classes.name: StepAdapter
classes.description: A PagerAdapter for managing and displaying a sequence of steps in a showcase/tutorial fragment, supporting callbacks for navigation buttons.

methods.name: StepAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with context and list of steps.

methods.name: setButtonCallbacks
methods.description: Sets callbacks for the finish, cancel, and next actions on pager buttons.

methods.name: instantiateItem
methods.description: Creates and configures the view for a specific step in the pager, including setting button actions.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Removes a view from the container.

methods.name: getStep
methods.description: Retrieves the step object at a given position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of steps.

methods.name: isViewFromObject
methods.description: Checks whether a view corresponds to a specific object.
